Text:
[II] Celebrating our Savior, who was born of the Virgin Mary, let us pray, saying:
[IR] Lord, look upon us like a mother to their children, and hear our prayer.
[I1] You are the Sun of Justice, who rose like the dawn from Mary's womb,
[I2] bask our ways and days forever in the light of Your presence.
[I1] Eternal Word, You chose Mary's womb to nurture you and keep you from sin,
[I2] keep and free us from the ways sin corrupts and destroys.
[I1] Our Savior, Your mother stood at the foot of Your cross,
[I2] grant us, with all the saints, joy as we share in the sufferings of Your passion.
[I1] Most generous Jesus, from the height of your cross you gave Mary to be the mother of John:
[I2] may our lives bear witness to also being her children, and your siblings.
Changes: 2025-02-08 - Paul Prins: Initial translation of these intentions
